hack.root_cause: Bridge private key leak from decommissioned server → unauthorized token minting → dump
hack.description: Hacken — the DeFi security auditing firm — had its own token's bridge minting key left exposed on a decommissioned server, letting an attacker mint 900M $HAI tokens and crash the price 99%, extracting ~$170K.
